criteria.detail: All non-event windows, VA minus conventional change on 10-year change: slope 0.0185, 90% month-block interval [-0.0303, 0.0658], n 904 (h=2, band 2). Knob points (h, band, slope): (2, 2, 0.0185); (2, 5, 0.0293); (5, 2, 0.0430); (5, 5, 0.0081); (10, 2, 0.0450); (10, 5, 0.0413). Reading: inside the floor.
criteria.name: B156-3
criteria.rival_entailment: An announcement that changes only the expected path of the policy rate reaches every household through that one Q_t sequence. A spread between two borrower classes on the same contract can then only be a constant wedge outside the policy channel, so its change over such a day is zero and its change on rate news generally is zero: the VA minus conventional spread does not load on the 10-year yield.
criteria.rival_premise: One intertemporal price schedule for every household: P_t C_t + Q_t B_{t+1} = B_t + W_t H_t + Pi_t, with no household index on the bond price Q_t; the edge field is w = d(phi), the same for every class.
